versions.short: The law renames the Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona as Chiricahua National Park, keeping the same boundaries and directing the Secretary of the Interior to manage it under the existing proclamations and general national park laws. It also requires the Secretary to protect traditional cultural and religious sites in the park, consult with Indian Tribes on that work, and give tribal members access to those sites for traditional uses, with the option of temporarily closing specific areas to the public at a tribe's request.
